{{Short description|Portuguese chemist (born 1979)}}
'''Nuno Maulide''' (born 1979) is a Portuguese [[chemist]]. As of 2023, he is professor of [[organic chemistry]] at the [[University of Vienna]], as well as a science-related writer and speaker.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-09-13 |title=Nuno Maulide é o autor da obra que desmistifica a Química simplicando-a |url=https://tecnico.ulisboa.pt/pt/noticias/campus-e-comunidade/nuno-maulide-e-o-autor-da-obra-que-desmisfica-a-quimica-simplicando-a/ |access-date=2023-09-05 |publisher=Técnico Lisboa |language=pt}}</ref> He is also an amateur [[pianist]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dias |first=Catarina Miranda, Miguel Viterbo |title=Nuno Maulide, cientista e pianista amador: "No laboratório socializa-se mais que na música" |url=https://observador.pt/programas/em-40-minutos/no-laboratorio-socializa-se-mais-que-na-musica/ |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=Observador |language=pt}}</ref> Son of a Mozambican father and a São Toméan mother, who were physicians, he was the first black professor at the institution in over six centuries of existence.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-25 |title=Nuno Maulide. A sinfonia da Química |url=https://www.contacto.lu/mundo/nuno-maulide-a-sinfonia-da-qu-mica/514412.html |access-date=2023-08-25 |website=contacto-online |language=pt}}</ref> He is also involved in [[Science communication|science divulgation]] and the popularization of chemistry, especially for children.<ref>{{cite web |title="650 offene Türen": Ein fulminanter Auftakt |url=http://medienportal.univie.ac.at/uniview/uniblicke/detailansicht/artikel/650-offene-tueren-ein-fulminanter-auftakt/}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-09-22 |title=Toalha húmida ao ombro para não chorar ao cortar cebola |url=https://www.dn.pt/ciencia/toalha-humida-ao-ombro-para-nao-chorar-ao-cortar-cebola-14145431.html |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=dn.pt |language=pt}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Nuno Maulide was born in [[Lisbon]] in 1979, son of a couple of [[Physician|medical doctors]] who were born in [[Portuguese Empire|Portuguese Africa]].<ref name="nit.pt">{{Cite web |title=Nuno Maulide: o super cientista sorridente que está a apaixonar os portugueses |url=https://www.nit.pt/cultura/livros/nuno-maulide-o-super-cientista-sorridente-que-esta-a-apaixonar-os-portugueses |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=NiT |language=pt}}</ref> His father, Ibraimo Maulide, was born in the then territory of [[Portuguese Mozambique]] and his mother, Ermelinda Xavier Daniel Dias Maulide, was born in the then territory of [[Portuguese São Tomé and Príncipe]]. They met each other while they were studying medicine at the Medical School of the [[University of Coimbra]], in Portugal, after the [[Carnation Revolution]] of 1974 and the eventual independence of the African territories where they were born.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nuno Maulide: O melhor divulgador de ciência na Áustria – DW – 07/02/2020 |url=https://www.dw.com/pt-002/nuno-maulide-o-melhor-divulgador-de-ci%C3%AAncia-na-%C3%A1ustria/a-52263755 |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=dw.com |language=pt}}</ref>

Nuno Maulide was raised in Lisbon, and after studies at the [[Instituto Superior Técnico]] in the same city and a master's degree in Molecular Chemistry at the [[Ecole Polytechnique]] in Paris, he underwent doctoral studies in the [[Université catholique de Louvain|University of Louvain]] (UCLouvain) in Belgium.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Nuno Maulide| doi=10.1002/anie.201402747|volume=53|issue = 31|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|page=7984|year = 2014}}</ref>

In 2007, he obtained his PhD under the supervision of Prof. Istvan Marko, working on the application of functionalized [[orthoester]]s in organic synthesis.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uclouvain.be/372324.html|title=UCL - PhD Students|access-date=2015-12-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222141743/http://www.uclouvain.be/372324.html|archive-date=2015-12-22|url-status=dead}}</ref> He then moved to [[Stanford University]] for a post-doctoral stay in the group of Prof. [[Barry Trost]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.stanford.edu/group/bmtrost/formermem.html|title=Former Group Members}}</ref> Nuno Maulide started his independent career in 2009, when he was appointed group leader at the [[Max Planck Institute for Coal Research]] in Mülheim an der Ruhr.

In 2013 at the age of 33<ref>{{Citation|last=HowToBecomeAProf|title=How to become a FULL professor at age 33|date=2013-12-02|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ucZETA7iTSk|accessdate=2017-10-26}}</ref> he moved to the University of Vienna, taking a position as Full Professor of Organic Synthesis (as the successor to [[Johann Mulzer]]). In 2012, Nuno Maulide was awarded a [[European Research Council]] Starting grant.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/projects-and-results/erc-funded-projects?f[0]=sm_field_cordis_project_funding%3AStarting%20Grant%20%28StG%29&f[1]=sm_field_cordis_project_call_yea%3A2011&f[2]=sm_field_cordis_project_hi_count%3AAustria|title=ERC Funded Projects|date=2017-02-22}}</ref> He currently holds a European Research Council Consolidator grant (awarded in 2015-16).<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://medienportal.univie.ac.at/presse/aktuelle-pressemeldungen/detailansicht/artikel/chemiker-nuno-maulide-erhaelt-erc-consolidator-grant/|title=Chemiker Nuno Maulide erhält ERC Consolidator Grant|website=medienportal.univie.ac.at|language=de|access-date=2017-10-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/document/file/erc_2015_cog_results_pe.pdf|title=ERC CoG results 2015-}}</ref> Nuno Maulide is also a member of the Young Academy of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite news|url=https://www.oeaw.ac.at/mitglieder-kommissionen/mitglieder-der-oeaw/klassen-und-junge-akademie/junge-akademie/aktuelles-termine/news-details/article/neue-mitglieder-2017/|title=Neue Junge Akademie Mitglieder 2017|access-date=2017-10-26|language=de}}</ref> and since 2017 serves in the Board of the [[Austrian Science Fund]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://m.fwf.ac.at/de/ueber-den-fwf/organisation/kuratorium/|title=Kuratorium|website=m.fwf.ac.at|language=de|access-date=2017-10-26}}</ref> He is also the founding Chair of the Division of Organic Chemistry of the [[Austrian Chemical Society]]. He has been Associate Editor at the [[American Chemical Society]] journals [[Organic Letters]] and [[JACS Au]] since 2018. Nuno Maulide is also Adjunct PI at the [[CeMM]] since 2018 and runs a large collaboration with [[Boehringer Ingelheim]], funded by the [[Christian Doppler Gesellschaft]], since 2019.

== Personal life ==
Maulide lives in [[Vienna]] with his wife, a [[Pharmacology|pharmacologist]]. He is an avid [[piano]] player and has employed his talent as a pianist in his public-speaking presentations about science themes.<ref name="nit.pt"/><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-11-14 |title=Nuno Maulide: "Quando toco piano frente a uma audiência, sinto-me mais vulnerável do que ao dar uma palestra" |url=https://www.dn.pt/sociedade/nuno-maulide-quando-toco-piano-frente-a-uma-audiencia-sinto-me-mais-vulneravel-do-que-ao-dar-uma-palestra-15342278.html |access-date=2023-09-05 |website=dn.pt |language=pt}}</ref> Nuno Maulide gave concerts on various occasions.<ref>{{cite web |title=News - Max-Planck-Institut für Kohlenforschung |url=http://www.kofo.mpg.de/en/news-events/news/scientist-changes-chemistry-for-claviature-nuno-maulide-plays-a-piano-concert-at-the-paulus-church}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-11-17 |title=Chemiker Nuno Maulide öffnet sein Herz am Piano |url=https://www.derwesten.de/staedte/muelheim/chemiker-nuno-maulide-oeffnet-sein-herz-am-piano-aimp-id10051043.html}}</ref> Notably, he was finalist in the 2012 International Amateur Piano Competition held in Manchester.<ref>{{cite web |title=Canadian Thomas Yu Ties for First Place in The 2012 International Amateur Piano Competition in Manchester, U.K. |url=http://ca.yamaha.com/fr/news_events/pianos_keyboards_instruments/piano_competition/}}</ref> He was also finalist and fourth place at the [[International Piano Competition for Outstanding Amateurs]] in Paris 2013.

* EurJOC Young Researcher Award (2015)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://esocxix.eventos.chemistry.pt/|title=19th European Symposium on Organic Chemistry}}</ref>

* Marcial Moreno-Manas Lectureship (2017) <ref>{{Cite web|url=https://chemie.univie.ac.at/en/news-events/aktuelles-befuellen/aktuelles-detail/news/nuno-maulide-receives-2017-marcial-moreno-manas-lectureship-award/|title=Nuno Maulide receives 2017 Marcial Moreno-Mañas Lectureship award}}</ref>
* Springer Heterocyclic Chemistry Award (2018)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/gp/about-springer/media/press-releases/corporate/nuno-maulide-to-receive-springer-heterocyclic-chemistry-award-2018/15454300|title=Nuno Maulide to receive Springer Heterocyclic Chemistry Award 2018}}</ref>
